column5: Review text
Visited CTR Tiffin Room, Bengaluru and had an amazing experience.
The dosa was incredibly crispy, flavorful, and unlike any dosa I have ever had before. The taste was truly unique and memorable.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bengaluru. Definitely one of the best dosa experiences I’ve had! 😊🙏
The ambience of the place feels very nostalgic and reflects the charm of the 70s era

The food, as expected, was outstanding. CTR truly serves one of the best Benne Masala Dosas in the world
